items.label: Material
items.value: 80%Viscose, 20%Polyamide. Crafted from soft knitted fabric, this ribbed tank tops for women offers a cozy feel. Tailored cut provides a polished look while maintaining comfort through the workday

items.label: Design
items.value: Sleeveless tops for women feature square neck, wide strap, scalloped neckline and cuffs, slim fit. Decorative scalloped trim adds feminine charm and elevates this basic tank to a standout wardrobe piece

items.label: Match
items.value: Classic square neck tank top women pairs beautifully with shorts, skirts, pants, or blazers for multiple outfit combinations

items.label: Occasion
items.value: The slimming tops for women is suitable for business casual office wear, brunches, shopping, dates night, going out, party, weekends, vacation, holiday and errands. Suitable for year-round use, wear alone in warm weather or layer under cardigans and jackets for cooler seasons

items.label: Note
items.value: Hand wash recommended, machine washable with laundry bag, do not bleach. Please carefully check our size chart before purchasing
